finalText:
The bug was in the start index calculation. Pages are 1-indexed, but the function was using `page * perPage` instead of `(page - 1) * perPage`. This made every request return the wrong slice—page 1 was getting page 2's data, page 2 was getting page 3's, and so on.

Fixed it by subtracting 1 from the page number before multiplying by items per page. All 5 tests now pass.
